name: Guuffetarez

abilities.name: Harvester's Wrath
abilities.description: Guuffetarez launches multiple meteors in the area which explodes on impact, indicated by a circular AoE, dealing high flame damage. Each meteor leaves a flaming area dealing continuous direct moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Wards
abilities.description: At 95% health and then every 10% health, Guuffetarez becomes invulnerable and summons four orange wards in front of it. You must shoot those with a flaming ballista, and when an orange ward is shot, a smaller blue one replaces it which must be shot at by a coldfire ballista instead. Once all the wards are destroyed, Guuffetarez loses its invulnerability. It also summons one champion enemy with many adds every time.

dialogue.speaker: Walks-in-Ash
dialogue.line: Let the storm of retribution wash over you, vile creature!
dialogue.trigger: Making your way through the western wing of the Fortress, Walks-in-Ash will have procured the Infernium from the Darkbinder Beast Handlers. After using it to blast through the gate, she will command it to attack Guuffetarez once you reach her. When the fight starts, Walks-in-Ash commands her infernium to fire upon Guuffetarez

dialogue.line: <The Infernium fires a magical beam at Guuffetarez.>
